scope: The first update shared from the new update place.

topics.title: Updates from the new place
details: This is the first update shared from the new place that holds only the installers.
You do not need to do anything. Companion finds updates in either place.

topics.title: Problems with sharing updates are easier to find
details: If an update cannot be shared to one place, the build now says so clearly. That helps fix it fast.
